autofill_fired.description: True if Chrome's password autofill populated both username and password fields within 3 seconds of focusing the username input. Null when the skill never got far enough to test (e.g., CDP unreachable, login page never loaded).

submit_outcome.description: Outcome after clicking submit. touch_id_pending means the 12-second budget elapsed with no URL change and no error visible — most likely macOS Touch ID OS-modal is blocking, but cannot be confirmed from DOM.
